architecture: MobileNetV3-Small shared encoder + U-Net ROI segmentation + 9-class classification
checkpoint: best_model.pth (training artifact; not required by the static web app)

preprocessing.cccd: For folder samples with true-label path cccd, run segmentation/classification from grayscale page and ROI replicated to RGB tensor. For an unlabeled single image, a manual grayscale option is available; otherwise rerun in grayscale if the preliminary RGB prediction is CCCD. No thresholding.

outputs.embedding_prototypes: prototypes.json; normalized 576D class means; compare with cosine similarity

rejection.rule: reject if top softmax confidence OR maximum prototype cosine is below its threshold

suggested_thresholds.basis: 1st percentile validation confidence and 5th percentile validation prototype cosine; validation contains documents only

rejection.caveat: Suggested values use document-only validation data; calibrate with non-document negatives before relying on unknown rejection.

validation.device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU
